title: Concept: Hex dependency declared from a local path
description: mix.exs declares a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine.
